title: LicenseDefinitionCustomPermission (Developer Preview) - Data API
description: Represents a licensed custom permission that controls access to a license's features when included in a custom permission set license definition. This object is available in API version 54.0 and later.

LicenseDefinitionId.description: ID of the custom permission set license definition that contains the licensed custom permission. This is a relationship field.

LicensedCustomPermissionId.description: ID of the licensed custom permission that you're including in the permission set license definition. On the CustomPermission object, the isLicensed field must equal true. This is a relationship field.
